none: PAS NLM-6658F2: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, possibly an irregular issue, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.06gms, die axis: 12
